result.summary: The page is largely intact and functional; the only notable issues are low-contrast secondary text (delivery fees and inactive tab labels) and slightly inconsistent alignment of the 'Fastest near you' carousel items.

issues.description: The delivery fee for 'Green Bowl Poké' (€0.90) and 'Smash Bros Burgers' (€2.40) is rendered in very light gray on a white background, giving it low contrast and making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1) against the white background.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels ('Search', 'Orders', 'Profile') are shown in a pale gray that is low contrast and difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray for unselected tab labels and/or increase the icon stroke contrast to improve legibility.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel under 'Fastest near you' is misaligned: the first card is inset from the left while the third card runs off the right edge, so the middle card ('Smash Bros Burgers') does not line up with its peers.
issues.suggestion: Align the carousel items to a consistent grid/gutter so cards start at the container's left padding and clip symmetrically at the right.
